data_quality.reason: the typical post reaches too few people to rank (median reach FB 1, IG 4; median engagement FB 0, IG 1). Scoring needs a median of at least 25 reach or 2 engagements on a channel. This is a distribution problem, not a copy problem.

guidance: Analytics are incomplete, so no performance lean is applied. Keep a balanced TIP/POV mix with one WHY or ASK, vary the graphic, and write the best hook you can.
